description: Battery Charts publishes statistics derived from German stationary battery registrations in the Marktstammdatenregister. RWTH Aachen University institutes ISEA and PGS provide interactive charts of energy capacity, power, installation counts, monthly additions and removals, technologies and commissioning trends. Home and industrial storage are mapped by district, while large storage is represented by individual systems and operator portfolios. The public charts expose download controls, but the export format was not checked. Data and graphics are free under CC BY 4.0; the upstream registry has its own German data licence. Coverage is Germany, with dates tied to commissioning, not registration and no single fixed release period stated. Recent months can change as registrations arrive. The provider filters implausible energy-to-power ratios, classifies assets by power and capacity, and substitutes monthly category averages for corrected entries. These choices and incomplete historical registration limit interpretation as a measured fleet census. Simulation uses include storage-capacity baselines and adoption scenarios. It relates to data-marktstammdatenregister-mastr-germany, but supplies a distinct cleaned statistical product. Revenue-index and live M5BAT measurements are separate site components and are not included in this record.
